channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about James Dolan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about James Dolan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Mike Brown, James Dolan
item.description:
“Thank you to [owner] Jim Dolan and the Knicks organization, [president] Leon [Rose], the front office, Mike Brown, my teammates— without them, none of this would be possible; they allow me to be me. I’m forever indebted to them.”

Jalen Brunson on Mike Brown, James Dolan, Jul 15, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan
item.description:
Charles Oakley:

“I was supposed to be on the Roommate podcast. I get a call the day before. They said, we have to cancel you. And then three weeks later, guess who was on there? Dolan. Dolan. I was shooting a commercial right across from the Garden and Cafe 31 and something else. We shot for one day, the next day somebody said, somebody said we had to shut it down. We had permission and everything. So he bullying me around the city, too.”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Jun 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Fat Joe on James Dolan
item.description:
“Very misunderstood. They villainize Mr. Dolan like almost like a Bruce Wayne, like a Batman movie and this is Gotham City. This man, all these watch parties, this man takes care of us.”

Fat Joe on James Dolan, Jun 8, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Donald Trump on James Dolan
item.description:
“[Dolan] has invited me, and I'm going. I'll be there. It could be Monday. Maybe I'll do both [Game 3 and Game 4].”

Donald Trump on James Dolan, Jun 4, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mike Brown on Leon Rose, James Dolan
item.description:
Ian Begley:Mike Brown on James Dolan:

“He challenges Leon [Rose]. He challenges me. He challenges the players in the right way. You want that from your boss. You want to be challenged, you want to be pushed. There's a way to do it, there's a way not to do it. My short time around him, he's been fantastic in that area. In the same breath, too, he's adamant if you bring to him what you need, then there's backing with it, he's adamant about trying to give you the best things possible to go get the job done. I really appreciate my short time being around him, especially with the horizontal and more importantly the vertical alignment this organization has.”

Mike Brown on Leon Rose, James Dolan, Jun 2, 2026. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Donald Trump on James Dolan
item.description:
Mr. Trump has said in recent weeks that he remains a Knicks fan and has been following the team’s progress.

“I really like Jim Dolan a lot, I’m really happy for him and the team,”

Donald Trump on James Dolan, May 27, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Phil Jackson on James Dolan
item.description:
“Dolan said to me, ‘Are you going to get run out of town by the media?’ I said, ‘I know who the media is; that doesn’t affect me,’”

Phil Jackson on James Dolan, Oct 30, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Adam Silver on James Dolan
item.description:
New York Knicks owner James Dolan has been pushing Silver behind the scenes, sources said.

“There’s a bunch of owners who see Dolan as their hero for pressing Silver on these questions but Silver is not giving us any answers,”

Adam Silver on James Dolan, Oct 18, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Charles Oakley on LeBron James, James Dolan
item.description:
Oakley relayed Dolan’s reaction to LeBron, who was about a year away from free agency and leaving Miami for a second stint with the Cavaliers.

“I walked back to LeBron and said, ‘This mother---er (Dolan) wouldn’t shake my hand,’”

Charles Oakley on LeBron James, James Dolan, Feb 3, 2022. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Patrick Ewing
item.description:
“It did hurt when (Ewing) didn’t stand up for me with Dolan. You play with someone for 10 years, I had his back,”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Patrick Ewing, Feb 3, 2022. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Latrell Sprewell
item.description:
Instead, Dolan refused Oakley’s handshake and wouldn’t look up, according to the book.

“You would have thought I did something to his wife. Sh--, Latrell Sprewell, who played five seasons with the Knicks, cursed at Dolan in front of Dolan’s wife when he returned to face the Knicks back in 2003, and they still became friends,”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Latrell Sprewell, Feb 3, 2022. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan
item.description:
Charles Oakley wasn’t surprised Patrick Ewing had trouble getting around the Garden, and he doesn’t understand why his former teammate would want an explanation from James Dolan.

“This man (Dolan) offered you a D-League job. There’s no respect behind your name,”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Mar 13, 2021. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan
item.description:
In a statement released by his lawyers,Oakley said:

“I am appreciative of the appeals court as I now have a chance to show the world what I said from day one was true. The truth is going to come out at trial and Dolan will be held responsible for what he did.”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Nov 16, 2020. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Max Rose on James Dolan, Charles Oakley
item.description:
“Again, the guy is a snowflake. He kicks fans out of the arena. Look what he did to Oakley and Charles Oakley is a legend. I’m just a congressman. Nothing would surprise me. What I will tell you is I’m not going to let Jim Dolan bully me. I’ve got swamp creatures in D.C. coming after me. I’m not worried about this guy. Come at me, bro. Come at me. But you’re going to lose. Which is, by the way, something that he’s very much accustomed to. So I’m sure this won’t be cataclysmic for him; it’ll just be another loss in a long series of losses. He’s a loser. He’s got to shut up and sell the team.”

Max Rose on James Dolan, Charles Oakley, Oct 10, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Stephon Marbury on James Dolan
item.description:
Stephon Marbury:

“C’mon man, c’mon. At New York Knicks, did you really just bring world wide sucker to the New York Knicks. … Really? You brought this dude here? Why? I’m a real New York Knicks fan. I’ve been a New York Knicks fan since I was a [kid]. …C’mon [Jim] Dolan man. You gotta be kidding me, man. You brought this dude here? Really? What’s going on man. There’s gotta be an explanation. Not him. Out of all people, you bring this dude here? You bring him to NYC? To New York? He ain’t got no credibility here. Nah.”

Stephon Marbury on James Dolan, Jun 25, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Patrick Ewing on James Dolan
item.description:
Ewing told ESPN Radio on The Bart and Hahn Show.

“He's one of the best players that I've played with. He's a part of the Knicks' history. He and Mr. Dolan need to get in a room somewhere and figure that out.”

Patrick Ewing on James Dolan, Mar 28, 2020. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Patrick Ewing on James Dolan
item.description:
“Whatever is going on with him and Mr. Dolan, like I've said before, it's something that needs to stop,”

Patrick Ewing on James Dolan, Mar 28, 2020. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Donald Trump
item.description:
“If you’re a former player and what happened to me when they [dragged] me out of there for no reason, and we got the tape and I didn’t do nothing, it’s like lynching somebody back in the ‘40s and ‘50s. [Dolan] don’t care. I hate to put him in the category of Donald Trump, I think he’s Trump’s nephew. He don’t care.”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Donald Trump, Mar 4, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on James Dolan
item.description:
Shaquille O’Neal laid it out on TNT Tuesday night.

“When Mr. Dolan was walking out of the arena the other day, the whole crowd was yelling ‘Sell the team.’ So whoever he hires, I just hope he doesn’t micromanage,”

Shaquille O'Neal on James Dolan, Feb 5, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on James Dolan
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Enes Kanter on Knicks owner James Dolan:

“We text. We’re actually really cool buddies now. I’ve got no problem with him. Some other people can have a problem with him, but I’ve got no problem with him.”

Enes Kanter Freedom on James Dolan, Dec 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Cole Aldrich on James Dolan
item.description:
said Cole Aldrich, a center on the 2013-14 team.

“It was kind of where did these people fit in? They’re around but they’re not part of us but they kind of are. Like, what? Because I know at the end of the day, Dolan was spending a lot of money to have these people consult for him and the franchise. It was curious because they were there, but what were they doing?”

Cole Aldrich on James Dolan, Nov 25, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: David Fizdale on James Dolan
item.description:
The Knicks coach revealed Tuesday that he has the backing of the one fan who matters most: Knicks owner James Dolan.

“Every game, every game. Jim Dolan comes in and gives me a vote of confidence, a pat on my back and really has just been incredibly encouraging over the last year and a half or whatever it’s been,”

David Fizdale on James Dolan, Nov 20, 2019. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on James Dolan
item.description:
Fertitta:

“I do think he's a great partner and he's quite a gentleman. He's very intelligent and I think that he's just run across some bad luck in the last few years with injuries and not getting a few players that he tried to get. But, you know, right when it gets to where things are really bad, you don't think they're going to be good again, I think Jim Dolan is gonna surprise you all. And he's gonna put a really good team out there with the Knicks in the years to come.”

Tilman Fertitta on James Dolan, Sep 21, 2019. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Michele Roberts on James Dolan
item.description:
“We should all insist that a zero tolerance policy needs to be implemented at arenas in the face of misconduct by fans. Players don’t have the luxury of being able to unilaterally ban unruly fans from the arenas a la [New York Knicks owner] James Dolan. The arenas, therefore, have to do a better job of insulating our players,”

Michele Roberts on James Dolan, Mar 14, 2019. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: David Fizdale on James Dolan
item.description:
“Mr. Dolan’s big thing is, are we sticking to our process? We are. That’s been the good part about it. Our situation with our roster is where we want it. Our star’s getting healthy. When the time comes for free agency and all of those things, I think we’re gonna be in a good position.”

David Fizdale on James Dolan, Dec 6, 2018. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Adam Silver on James Dolan, Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Mark Jackson
item.description:
Stephen A Smith to Adam Silver on supporting Mark Jackson bc Knicks need a spokesperson:

“I like Steve Mills & Scott Perry but they need a voice that speaks to the media every day & it can't be one of the players & we both know it'll never be James Dolan.”

Adam Silver on James Dolan, Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Mark Jackson, Apr 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Donald Sterling on James Dolan, Charles Oakley
item.description:
“Oakley compared me to Dolan? Isn’t that amazing. I feel bad about Oakley. I wish that he could understand that there are no hard feelings by Dolan towards him. Owners don’t have hard feelings towards the players,”

Donald Sterling on James Dolan, Charles Oakley, Feb 17, 2017. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Vin Baker on James Dolan
item.description:
Jordan Schultz:Text from Vin Baker:

“[Dolan] called me sounding really sad asking me if I would come sit w/him. Hadn't spoke to him in 15 years.”

Vin Baker on James Dolan, Feb 12, 2017. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan
item.description:
“I wouldn’t mind having a sit-down dinner with Dolan. I wouldn’t mind cooking him dinner.”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Nov 2, 2016. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Adam Silver
item.description:
“I asked the commissioner (Adam Silver) to set up a meeting with (Dolan), make a step forward,”

Charles Oakley on James Dolan, Adam Silver, Feb 11, 2015. Source: New York Daily News.
